units.title: Motion and forces
units.why: Mechanics explains how objects move and interact, from transport to sport and safety.
examples: A 20 m displacement in 4 s gives average velocity 5 m/s
A 2 kg object with net force 6 N accelerates at 3 m/s²
misconceptions: mass and weight are the same
practice: Calculate velocity for 30 m in 5 s.
Find acceleration from 4 to 10 m/s in 3 s.
quizQuestions: What does slope of velocity-time graph show?

videoPackage.title: Motion and net force
videoPackage.transcript: We define direction carefully, read graphs using slope, and calculate net force with SI units and a labelled free-body diagram.
